description: PLANNER-SCHEMA campaign, for the tools/stage_a_cycle.py flow. The Dynamo batch executor does NOT consume this file -- it consumes a BATCH (batch_id/created_at/document/execution_policy/jobs), which the planner emits from this via generate_next_batch. Handing this file straight to the executor fails with 'Missing batch fields'. To run the jobs directly in Dynamo without the planner, use the ready-made batches tests/dynamo/campaigns/p0_export_correctness_a.json and _b.json instead. Executes the P0 G5 Revit checkpoint for Stage A export correctness. Every acceptance decision here is an automated comparator (tools/p0_export_comparators.py) reading values the production pipeline already records; the one human decision is which view p0.derived runs against, because only a person looking at the model can say which plan view is the right representative of the cap binding on the derived axis. Probe-only overrides (underlay off, raised sizing cap) apply inside a rolled-back TransactionGroup and are graded on being restored. No production default is modified by any job.

mob_1_level_2.notes: The P0 checkpoint view. Underlay is disabled on this view only, by the probe, inside the rolled-back group. It also carries p0_enumeration_anchor: p0.select is document-wide and reads no view geometry, but every job must name a view_key, and the executor resolves that view and hands it over as raw_view -- which is how p0.select reaches the document at all. The anchor is this view rather than a second registry entry for it, so one real view is not registered twice.

derived_axis_candidate.notes: Filled in from p0.select's derived_job_candidates after the manual review closes. Must be a view whose cap_binding_axis is 'derived' -- the 8695x10028 shape a fitted-axis-only cap waves through.

stages.description: Read-only enumeration of plan views, reporting the pre-cap request, fitted axis, predicted w x h, and whether the cap binds and on which axis. Mutates nothing and exports nothing.

jobs.manual_review_reason: A human selects the view p0.derived runs against from derived_job_candidates. No comparator can make this choice: it needs a person to confirm the candidate is a representative plan view rather than an artifact of a stale crop.

stages.description: The three capture jobs. p0.default and p0.override are independent of each other and of every s2.* job; only p0.derived waits, and only on p0.select's manual review.

acceptance_requirements.notes: Every check below is automated and produces PASS or FAIL with no manual review. hard_ratio of null (rendered '-' in the metrics table) is a FAIL in every job and is never skipped: analyze_stage_a_probe computes hard/(hard+blended) and returns null when no edges were counted at all, so a reader checking for 1.0 who sees '-' would read 'no data yet' when the real state is 'nothing was measured'.
p0.override: no attempt over the ceiling is recorded as a pass
final dim_check == pass, OR backoff_stop_reason in {retry_limit, grid_floor} AND the view failed with export_dim_mismatch
